verdict.rationale: Raygun docs confirm automatic grouping via exception type, class name, method name, and stack-trace location (raygun-docs-7), matching the fingerprinting claim, and users can mark errors resolved or set ignore rules (raygun-docs-10, raygun-docs-11). However, there is no evidence of a mechanism to manually re-group, split, or merge misgrouped errors when the automatic fingerprinting is wrong. Missing for 10: explicit customization/override controls for grouping logic, independent confirmation that grouping works reliably at scale.
